name: Wrist Flexor Stretch

instructions.description: Extend one arm forward with palm facing up.
Use the other hand to guide the fingers gently downward.
Keep the elbow soft and shoulder relaxed.
Release and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Wrist Flexor Stretch — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Keep the elbow comfortable and avoid forcing the wrist.
